field_use_cases.text: Best for single-line responses like client names, job titles, or short answers.

field_use_cases.email: Best for capturing client email with automatic syntax validation and copy delivery.
field_use_cases.tel: Best for emergency contact numbers, mobile phone, or SMS reminder opt-ins.
field_use_cases.date: Best for client date of birth, consultation date, or procedure scheduling.
field_use_cases.number: Best for client age, quantitative pain scales, or treatment session count.
field_use_cases.checkbox: Best for single agreement toggles, terms acceptance, or waiver opt-in.
field_use_cases.checkbox_group: Best when clients need to select multiple applicable options or medical symptoms.
field_use_cases.radio: Best when client must choose exactly one option from a mutually exclusive list.
field_use_cases.select: Best for compact dropdown selection among many options like states or services.
field_use_cases.section_header: Best for dividing form into distinct themed subsections with instructions.
field_use_cases.container: Best for grouping related questions into a bordered panel box or intake card.
field_use_cases.section_group: Best for organizing complex intake blocks into collapsible, manageable section groups.
field_use_cases.header: Best for prominent alerts, clinical warnings, preparation steps, or studio notices.
field_use_cases.signature: Best for legally binding client drawing pad signature on consent and waivers.

integrity.modal_subtitle: Comprehensive diagnostic scan for circular logic loops, missing choice options, and validation bounds
integrity.all_passed_desc: Your form structure, field options, and conditional logic graphs are fully verified with 0 detected integrity flaws.
integrity.copied_toast: Data integrity report copied to clipboard!
integrity.notice_prompt: ⚠️ Data Integrity Notice: Your form has {critical} critical and {error} error diagnostic(s). Click Cancel to inspect with Data Integrity Checker, or OK to proceed.
integrity.perfect_desc: No circular logic dependencies, missing options, inverted validation limits, or duplicate CRM aliases detected. Your form is production ready for client intake and PDF exports!
integrity.no_category_issues: No issues found in this specific category. Select "All Issues" above to view other diagnostics.
integrity.issue_opts_empty_desc: This {fieldType} has 0 options configured. Clients will have nothing to select.
integrity.issue_opts_empty_rec: Add at least 1-2 selectable options (e.g. "Yes / No" or custom choices).
integrity.issue_opts_blank_desc: Options exist in the list but contain only empty whitespace.
integrity.issue_opts_blank_rec: Provide readable names for each option choice.
integrity.issue_opts_dupe_desc: Option "{opt}" appears multiple times in the list, which can cause ambiguous client responses.
integrity.issue_opts_dupe_rec: Ensure each option choice has a distinct, unique label.
integrity.issue_logic_cycle_desc: Field #{id} is locked in an infinite dependency cycle ({chain}).
integrity.issue_logic_cycle_rec: Remove or reassign the conditional logic parent on one of the looped fields to break the deadlock.
integrity.issue_orphan_nofield_title: Orphaned Conditional Logic: No Trigger Selected
integrity.issue_orphan_nofield_desc: Conditional logic is turned ON, but no parent trigger question is selected.
integrity.issue_orphan_nofield_rec: Select a valid preceding question or disable the conditional toggle.
integrity.issue_orphan_deleted_desc: This field depends on question (#{id}) which no longer exists in the form.
integrity.issue_orphan_deleted_rec: Re-assign condition to an existing question or remove the rule.
integrity.issue_self_dep_desc: Field is set to trigger based on its own value, causing it to never appear.
integrity.issue_self_dep_rec: Select a different preceding field as the trigger or disable conditional logic.
integrity.issue_label_missing_desc: Field of type "{type}" has no prompt or question text.
integrity.issue_label_missing_rec: Enter a clear, descriptive question or instructions for the client.
integrity.issue_num_bounds_desc: Min value ({min}) is greater than Max value ({max}). No input can satisfy this constraint.
integrity.issue_num_bounds_rec: Adjust min to be less than or equal to max.
integrity.issue_len_bounds_desc: Min length ({min}) exceeds Max length ({max}). Form validation will fail on all client entries.
integrity.issue_len_bounds_rec: Adjust min character length to be smaller than max.
integrity.issue_regex_invalid_desc: Regular expression pattern has syntax error: {error}
integrity.issue_alias_dupe_desc: Alias "{alias}" is shared by {count} fields ({fields}). This causes field collisions upon CRM export.
integrity.issue_alias_dupe_rec: Assign unique aliases to each field.
integrity.issue_sec_empty_desc: Section "{title}" has no fields placed inside it.
integrity.issue_sec_empty_rec: Add questions into this section or delete the empty section.
integrity.issue_cycle_desc: Fields form an infinite mutual visibility loop involving {count} conditional branches
integrity.issue_cycle_rec: Break the cycle by removing or inverting the conditional trigger logic on one of the involved fields.
integrity.issue_orphan_missing_desc: This field depends on parent field "{parentId}", which does not exist in the form
integrity.issue_orphan_missing_rec: Re-assign the conditional parent to an active field, or click Quick-Fix to safely disable the rule.
integrity.empty_category: No issues detected in this category!
